title: FACTSET RESEARCH SYSTEMS INC 8-K Filing — 2026-04-08
summary: FactSet Research Systems Inc. filed an 8-K announcing CFO transition: Helen Shan departing effective April 13, 2026, with Joshua Warren appointed as successor. Warren's compensation includes $500,000 base salary, 110% target bonus, $2.25M annual equity award target, and $1.5M new hire equity grant.
key_points: Helen Shan, CFO, will transition out effective April 13, 2026
Joshua Warren appointed as new CFO, commencing April 13, 2026
Warren's compensation: $500,000 base salary, 110% target cash bonus
Annual equity award target: $2,250,000 starting FY2027
New hire equity grant: $1,500,000 total ($750K stock options, $500K RSUs, $250K cash)
Warren previously served as CFO of Envestnet (2023-2025) and held senior roles at BlackRock
